dct_description_sm:
This dataset represents 14 cycling routes/tours within Durham Region and were included in the 2017 Durham Cycle Tours Map.


Users of this dataset bear full responsibility for their own safety, by downloading the user is agreeing to the following: 

I acknowledge and agree, the Durham Cycle Tours data has been developed to assist recreational cyclists in planning trips. The routes are intended for use by experienced cyclists and should be evaluated by each individual cyclist based on their level of experience, comfort level in cycling in mixed traffic, weather conditions, time of day, posted speed, changing road grades and any road obstacles or conditions, whether temporary or permanent, such as construction or potholes. Experienced cyclists are considered to be those who have completed the CAN-BIKE level 2 course, or equivalent. This map is not intended as a guide for children. 

I acknowledge, the Regional Municipality of Durham makes no warranties of any kind concerning the accuracy, reliability or completeness of the Durham Cycle Tours data or the safe condition of any road, route, trail or facility whatsoever shown on it. I acknowledge that as a user of this data I am solely responsible for the risks associated with this data’s use, as well as my own safety when using the data. Cyclists are reminded that they must comply with the Highway Traffic Act and are encouraged to always use safety equipment when cycling. I acknowledge and agree that the Region of Durham is not responsible for any offences committed by third parties, which may cause a hazard or injury to cyclists.
